 Get involved Live Reporting
 Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 19:24 GMT 19:24 GMT 
 FT: Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 That game changed when Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown a red card but Spurs look a completely different side in recent weeks. 
 67 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 19:22 GMT 19:22 GMT 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Image source, Getty Images Spurs pick up their third Premier League win on the spin for the first time in 20 months. 
 Is Roberto de Zerbi building something in north London?
 721 77 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:21 GMT 19:21 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Glasner had a worse start to his first full season. That turned out alright.
 Richard, London 
 242 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:21 GMT 19:21 GMT 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Jobi McAnuff 
Former Crystal Palace winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 I would like to think Crystal Palace fans and the hierarchy give Sage a bit of slack. Incredible play by Luca Williams-Barnett, dribbling and taking players on. Crosses the ball across the six-yard box and Mohammed Kudus has to score. He is two yards out. 
 225 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 90+2 mins 90+2 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 We're into three minutes of added time as Dean Henderson pulls off another top save. 
 This time it's Dejan Kulusevski trying to pick out the top bins. 
 257 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 90+1 mins 90+1 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 How good is that from Luca Williams-Barnett?
 The 18-year-old skins his man before teeing it up for Mohammed Kudus but he sticks it wide. 
 Should score. 
 509 47 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 89 mins 89 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Mathys Tel's night is over and here comes youngster Luca Williams-Barnett. 
 For Palace, Adam Wharton and Daichi Kamada are replaced by Jefferson Lerma and Will Hughes. 
 290 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 88 mins 88 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Image source, Getty Images Pedro Porro has absolutely wellied that but it's flown the wrong side of the post. 
 227 69 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:15 GMT 19:15 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Give Sage time. I think it will take a bit longer for him to implement his style and maybe like De Zerbi is for Spurs now, Sage could turn the season around. Sacking managers in today’s game is too frequent.
 Edward, London 
 636 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 DISALLOWED GOAL published at 85 mins 85 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Mohammed Kudus has the ball in the net for Spurs' third but the flag is quickly raised for offside.
 Turns out he's about two yards off. 
 172 337 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Tonali and Fernandes 'growing' under De Zerbi published at 19:12 GMT 19:12 GMT 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Jobi McAnuff 
Former Crystal Palace winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Image source, Getty Images Sandro Tonali has been good. That relationship with Mateus Fernandes seems to be growing. Of course, today in different circumstances against one less player, but it hasn't all been easy. That is one sign of improvement under Roberto de Zerbi in recent weeks.
 507 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 We're finally into the final 10 minutes of this one. I feel like it's been going on all day this game. 
 That's what a day full of football does to you. 
 234 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 82 mins 82 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 The ball drops to Conor Gallagher in the box, he takes it under control and drills one towards the corner but Dean Henderson pulls off a top save. 
 262 115 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 80 mins 80 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Palace are on course for their sixth defeat in nine games this season. 
 Is Pierre Sage the right man to lead them forward? Thoughts, Palace fans?
 232 222 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:06 GMT 19:06 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Image source, Reuters The anxious wait is over I guess.
 Nathan, Dorset 
 583 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 78 mins 78 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 More changes for Spurs with Destiny Udogie and Dejan Kulusevski replacing Omar Marmoush and Mohammed Kudus. 
 For Palace, Dwight McNeil makes way for Dario Osorio. 
 310 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 76 mins 76 mins 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Barring a miracle from Palace, Spurs are on their way to a third win on the bounce and are up to eighth in the Premier League table. 
 712 91 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Brilliant reaction from Van Hecke' published at 19:03 GMT 19:03 GMT 
 Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Jobi McAnuff 
Former Crystal Palace winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 A fantastic delivery from Fernandes. Jan Paul van Hecke is the one who wants to get the contact on the ball. It comes back out and hits Van Hecke again. It was a brilliant reaction from Van Hecke. 
 599 65 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace published at 19:01 GMT 19:01 GMT 
 Jan Paul van Hecke (73 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images Game = over. 
 Spurs' long wait for a second goal is over and it's defender Jan Paul van Hecke who throws himself at Mateus Fernandes' stunning ball in. 
 Dean Henderson makes the save onto the bar but Van Hecke heads it over the line while sitting on the grass.
 1936 437 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:01 GMT 19:01 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Image source, Reuters Anxious waiting for Tottenham to score another goal and put the game to bed. They are playing against 10 men and still struggling to score. We need another goal.
 Nathan, Dorset
